text: GraphRAG combines knowledge graphs with retrieval-augmented generation for complex corpus queries.
Microsoft Research developed GraphRAG and supports local, global, and DRIFT-style search.
Agentic RAG iteratively plans retrieval, inspects evidence, and may reformulate a query.
Ontologies constrain entity classes and relation semantics such as domain and range.
Claim-level provenance links generated claims to source spans or graph paths.
